profile.headline: Full stack developer at Deloitte.
profile.summary: Web developer, fast learner with a hands on approach, personable and punctual. My time in the navy taught me how to process and repurpose large amounts of technical data. very enthusiastic about the software development field, goal oriented, driven and a hard worker.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.insights: AWS Lambda, Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) and +5 skills

positions.title: Jr fullstack developer

positions.title: software engineering Immersive
positions.description:
Learned the foundations of front and back end web development using HTML5, CSS3, javascript, react.js, node.js, mongoose, express, python, flask, django, postgresql, and mongoDB.

The software engineering Immersive focused on the mern stack but also taught the basics of python, flask, django, and sql queries.

positions.title: Supervisor
positions.description:
•	Assisted in maintaining over two million dollars’ worth of equipment through properly completing scheduled maintenance plan.
•	Personally responsible for fabrication/installation of ships Search and Rescue equipment  as well as training all non-qualified personnel resulting in an overall score of 98% through written and practical examinations.
•	Personally supervised and managed 13 personnel through day to day tasks and successfully completed all given tasks in a timely manner with little supervision from managers.
•	Routinely inspected equipment for defects or conditions hazardous to personnel safety resulting in over 230 exercises with 0 safety mishaps
